headline: A 2018 law renamed the federal building and courthouse at 1300 Victoria Street in Laredo, Texas, after judge George P. Kazen.
what_it_does: The law gives an official new name to a federal building and U.S. courthouse in Laredo, Texas. It names the building the "George P. Kazen Federal Building and United States Courthouse." It does not change how the building is used, who works there, or how cases are handled.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 27, 2018.
